extraction.title: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Aug. 5, 2026
extraction.description: COA auditor Roderick Wamil returns to the witness stand, this time to answer clarificatory questions from senator-judges.
extraction.text: MANILA, Philippines – On the 13th day of Vice President Sara Duterte impeachment trial, former Commission on Audit (COA) Intelligence and Confidential Funds Audit Office auditor Roderick Wamil returns to the witness stand, this time to answer clarificatory questions from senator-judges on his testimony regarding the alleged misuse of confidential funds.
